1.

In hope our longing glances we lift, Soon the Morning Star kindly toward us smiles; How joyful, how sweet shall His coming be, Ere the Sun in its majesty appears!

2.

What joy to behold His countenance, Which in the night’s darkness has granted us comfort; To hear His voice, which has so encouraged us, Whose slightest whisper has filled our breast with peace!

3.

If the thought of our Lord’s love here Already can lift above earth’s dust; If heaven’s foretaste teaches the weary wanderer To sing gladly on the way to the Father’s house—

4.

What then shall the radiance of His glory, The greatness of His love from us call forth, If not praise and worship in eternity, A deep, united homage to God’s Lamb!
